name: LMM Forge
compApproval: No comp was approved. The user approved monochrome, sharp lettering, and strong contrast.

provenance.method: Authored filled paths from explicit coordinates. No font outlines, generated raster, stock art, external references, scripts, or font requests are used.
provenance.proofRasterOrigin: Rasterized from the authored SVG paths for size and contrast inspection only.

geometry.connectivity: One filled silhouette, connected through the L base; two internal counterforms.

symbol.opticalRisk: At 16 px the 8-unit L-to-M gap is one pixel and each M stem is 1.5 pixels. Keep the full viewBox and use native size rasterization; avoid additional padding inside a tiny icon slot.

lettering.units: One cap height equals 100 geometry units.

horizontalLockup.spacingIntent: The L closes toward the first M; paired M stems retain more air. F/O closes around the F's open lower half. Rounded bowls receive extra separation from vertical stems. The word break is deliberately larger than any letter gap.

lettering.opticalRisk: FORGE is display lettering. Use the compact symbol below a 20 px cap height. The R counter and G aperture need enough pixels to stay distinct.

compositionGuidance.reuse: Insert these exact paths with fill-rule=evenodd. Scale groups uniformly. Preserve within-group positions; LMM and FORGE may be composed independently as two lines.
compositionGuidance.clearSpace: For ordinary logo placement, leave at least one 20-unit wordmark stem or one 18-unit symbol spine around the artwork. The full symbol viewBox already provides its small-icon optical margin.
